name: lumi-skill-ecommerce-ops
description: E-commerce operations pack for product listings, order profit, inventory, settlement, campaign ROI, after-sales risk, privacy-safe review ingestion and insights, and combined operating snapshots.

lumi.setupNote: Analyzes supplied marketplace records with read-only tools. Review imports support CSV, TSV, JSON, JSONL, deduplication, pagination, and PII masking. Publishing, replies, listing edits, inventory changes, refunds, and ad spend require separately authenticated tools and post-action evidence.
